अह्वल a. Not fluctuating, firm,
steady.
--ला N. of a tree (भल्लातक).

आह्वृ {c1c} P. Ved. To make crooked,
injure.

आह्वरकः A low or expelled man
(who, after having offered a sacrifice
to the manes, takes the sacrificial
food for himself); अन्नमपहर्तार
आह्वरका भवंति थाद्धे सिद्धे

Yajur-veda.

what calls, a crier.
--2 Named,
called.
